name: gf-space-sector-octroi
description: French Guiana space-sector import relief reference for operations from August 2026 under territorial deliberations AP-2026-56 and AP-2026-57. Explains the residual octroi rate, continuing regional levy, activity and goods annex requirements, exclusive operational use, service-operator evidence and restrictions on combining exemptions. Includes an illustrative computation and exclusion cases for ordinary logistics and goods with alternative uses. This is a narrow source-cited draft, not automatic eligibility for every space supplier or a complete customs filing manual. Independent review, exact goods classification and current amendment checks remain necessary before application.
